QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Petulant Eurenth the Sage
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bReclamation HQ Commander Barracks#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea wants you to find #bEurenth#k, once called a great sage, to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon of the Nova. Eurenth is living alone in #b#m401020100##k in the #bForbidden Forest#k...
QuestInfo.2: You met Eurenth in the Forbidden Forest. He does indeed have a petulant temper as Edea said...

0.0: We are not done building our military strength. There is another way beyond merely training the soldiers, and it's creating a powerful weapon.
0.1: The Nova have a mighty weapon called the #bBlue Dragon Cannon#k. It can break a city wall in a single shot. However, it was mostly lost in the battle with Magnus.
0.2: It can be restored, if we have the right person for the job. We need #bEurenth#k... He was once called a great sage of the Nova, but now is an old man living alone in #bhis hut in the Forbidden Forest#k.
0.3: Find him, and inquire about how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon. It won't be easy since... well, he's known to be rather petulant. Perhaps being a 'great sage' went to his head. These days, he stays in the forest and never comes out. Good luck getting him to cooperate.\r\n#e#r* If you accept, you will move to the field.#k\r\n

yes.0: Oh, don't mention me to Eurenth. There's a good chance he might be inspired to...do something mean.

no.0: You don't want to see Eurenth? Believe me, I understand.

npc.0: Find #bEurenth#k in #bhis hut in the Forbidden Forest#k. He should know how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon.
